# agentpc

agentpc gives AI agents instant, resettable Windows, Ubuntu and Arch Linux ARM desktop VMs on an Apple Silicon Mac, through one MCP server (`agentpc mcp`).

The VMs are ARM64. x64 Windows apps run through Prism; x86_64 and i386 Linux programs and amd64 containers run in the `ubuntu-x86apps` and `arch-x86apps` images, through FEX. The `arch` guest (Arch Linux ARM) is like Ubuntu, with Chromium as its browser and pacman (`sudo pacman -Syu --noconfirm <pkg>`) for packages.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://agentpc.pawanpaudel.com.np/install.sh | sh
```
